what: After a table operation was added to ProductInfo_Table, the build failed with XMI ID collisions on admin tabular reference actions and a UI generator NullPointerException (ActionDefinition.getIsExportAction null) on CategoryInfo Products RelationTablePage. Removing the operation fixed the build.
why: Not explained in the chunk; the NPE was in a generated page of a different entity than the one changed.
workaround: Deleted the ProductInfo table operation (delete --cascade) and created the import operation on a new ImportedProductInfo transfer object with a Products table operation.

what: The generated file upload button in the admin import dialog has only a title ('Upload file') and wraps a hidden file input, so getByRole('button', name) cannot find it in Playwright; getByTitle works.
why: Generated BinaryInput widget gives the upload control no accessible name.
workaround: Test uses getByTitle('Upload file') and the file chooser event.

what: In the generated export dialog, keys typed into the date range fields in one burst were lost, and typing into the second date field reset the first in form state (the request sent only toDate or only fromDate).
why: Builder's diagnosis: generated date widget loses input when typed fast and the second field resets the first.
workaround: Test types the date in segments with a pause, waits for the template request, and waits 1.5 s before typing; the until filter was dropped from the test.

what: 'Ordered' is a custom field and the generator draws custom fields after the generated ones, so after the move it sits just above the buttons; field order in the order view is not fully controllable.
why: Custom fields are placed after generated fields; the field-order platform bug may apply.
workaround: Used the CLI move command to reorder the generated fields; left Ordered last.

what: A derived effectivePrice Price value on WishlistItemInfo was replaced by a derived string priceLabel with ' EUR' appended; the reason for the change is not stated in the chunk.
why: Not stated in the chunk.
workaround: Replaced effectivePrice with priceLabel (String) on the wishlist table and view.

what: Customer view fields that the page must load but not show (effectivePrice, onSale, ratingLabel, image, sale fields) were hidden with customImplementation=true and render-nothing components, because no view-field hook exists.
why: ui-hooks.md covers AppBar, hero, logo, footer and menu only; the only mechanism is a model-level custom implementation (already logged as a gap).
workaround: Layout-only components render the values in ProductDetailsLayout and CatalogHome.

what: Database not migrated for the new tables and columns; ./judo.sh schema-upgrade fails with a Maven ProjectBuildingException, so the containers and volumes were wiped and all earlier data is gone.
why: Known platform issue (R6-1, R10-3); the schema-evolution route in the kb does not work on this project.
workaround: Wiped containers and volumes, restarted, reran seed-dev-user.sh.

what: Sorting by a derived aggregate gives a generated-SQL error (missing FROM-clause entry), and a nested filter or filter plus sort over the same type gives 'table name _iterator_N specified more than once' at runtime (HTTP 500 on the dashboard and on coupon creation).
why: Platform JQL-to-SQL generator bug for these expression shapes.
workaround: Made soldUnits a stored aggregate, maintained by checkout, cancel and return approval, and sorted on it with one selector.
proposed_target: JQL to SQL generator (sort over derived member, nested lambda over same type)

what: The table column customizer hook key is imported by the generated tables but nothing consumes it, so a hook registered for a column never applies. The catalog's Custom Columns section presents it as working.
why: Grep over the generated frontend found no consumer of TABLE_COLUMN_CUSTOMIZER_HOOK_INTERFACE_KEY; the platform does not wire it.
workaround: Not used; wishlist moved to a custom component.

what: Setting DataColumn.customImplementation=true makes the generated table use useTrackService without importing it, so pnpm build fails with TS2304 in every such table. The builder also reports that TransferObjectTable.customImplementation is accepted by the CLI and does nothing.
why: Generator emits a call to a hook it does not import; the table-level flag has no effect in the generated code.
workaround: Reverted customImplementation on the columns, set it only on the table, then used a custom view page.
proposed_target: generator: DataColumn customImplementation emits useTrackService without import; TransferObjectTable.customImplementation no-op

what: In the drawer, the generated layout stacks the AppBar extra components as a column, so the bell button stretched over the full drawer width and showed as a grey ellipse.
why: Generated layout of AppBar extra components has no documented row layout; the builder fixed it by wrapping them in one Box.
workaround: One flex Box wrapper inside AppBarExtras.

what: The generated application/integration-test/pom.xml declares hu.blackbelt.osgi.i18n:i18n-api with an empty version element, so Maven cannot read the project ('dependencies.dependency.version ... is missing').
why: Template or generator bug in the integration-test pom fragment; the empty element is not filled from a property.
workaround: Hand-written order-tests module with the version filled in.

what: The generated playwright.config.ts sets retries: 4 unconditionally (the template comment says retry on CI only). The catalog's troubleshooting page documents the fix as retries: process.env.CI ? 4 : 0.
why: Generator template ignores the CI condition; catalog already describes the fix.
workaround: Separate playwright.ci.config.ts and playwright.local.config.ts (not generated).

what: 'playwright install chromium' hangs during extraction on this machine, so the local config uses the installed Google Chrome channel.
why: Environment-specific install hang on the builder's machine.
workaround: playwright.local.config.ts with channel chrome and retries 0.

what: Enumeration members have no label field (EnumerationMemberUpdateInput has only name, documentation, ordinal), so UI status text must come from a derived string member.
why: Platform input type for enumeration members; the builder read it from the GraphQL input type.
workaround: Derived statusLabel member on ReturnRequest mapped into the screens.

what: Each model change cost a stop, generate, build and start cycle of about 3 to 5 minutes (fixed sleeps of 125 to 150 seconds), and the full Playwright runs took about 8 minutes (admin) and 21 minutes (customer).
why: Full redeploy for each model edit and no hot reload used in this round.
workaround: Batched model edits before builds; ran full suites once at the end.

what: Frontend build logs show 'XMI ID COLLISION DETECTED' errors for the admin and customer models, but the build still succeeded. The builder did not investigate them.
why: Generator reassigns the same XMI ids to Action objects; cause not checked.
proposed_target: generator: duplicate XMI ids for TabularReferenceField actions

what: Generated customer frontend fails Biome with a duplicate import: ShopMessage and ShopMessageStored are imported twice when an operation returns a mapped type.
why: Generator emits duplicate imports for a mapped operation output (already recorded as GAPS R8-5, referenced in the checkout hook comment).
workaround: Builder removed the output parameter from the invite operations (-u output), so the generator stopped emitting the import.

what: Build failed with XMI ID COLLISION errors on Admin TabularReferenceField link actions, then ActionContainerSameWithActionDefinition, after new relation-field and action edits.
why: Cause not stated in the chunk. The collision names the Admin TabularReferenceField link actions, and the builder had just added a TabularReferenceField (OrderInfo_Form returns). Not confirmed.
workaround: Builder deleted and re-added table operations and rebuilt; the next build passed after the output change.

what: Frontend Maven step fails at pnpm install with ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS (core-js-pure, esbuild), so the format step fails and the build stops; the same message is in an earlier build log.
why: pnpm blocks dependency build scripts that are not approved; the generated build does not approve them.
workaround: Builder ran npx biome directly instead of pnpm run format.

what: Running mvn compile in application/app failed in the PSM generator with: there are manual changes in the generated files, discard them or add them to .generator-ignore.
why: Generator checksum guard sees changed generated files. Likely related to c08-09 but not proven in the chunk.
workaround: Builder ran judo.sh generate-root and judo.sh build instead, which passed.

what: Invitation key blueprint assumes an anonymous actor, so the invitee cannot accept the key without a Keycloak account. The builder adds sign-up first, then key entry, and shows the key in the admin table and log.
why: Chunk does not show why anonymous acceptance was not used. GAPS R13-3 records the decision as platform limit with no mail server.
workaround: Key shown in the open-invitations table and logged; invitee signs up, then enters key on Join a company; acceptance checks key, expiry and e-mail and deletes the invitation in one transaction.

what: After the build, app start logged NoClassDefFoundError for hu/blackbelt/epsilon/runtime/execution/contexts/EolExecutionContext and Could not find compatible schema model; the same error appears in the round 12 start log.
why: Not resolved in this chunk. Looks like a platform runtime or classpath issue, not a model error.
workaround: Builder kept going; the app answered HTTP 200 on the admin URL.

what: After the buyer joins with the key, the My company menu does not appear until the shell starts again.
why: Builder comment says menu entries are decided from the principal read at shell start, so a page change does not refresh them.
workaround: Post-join hook calls window.location.assign on the start URL to reload the shell.

what: Generated action group shows the first three actions; Request a quote sits under the Actions menu in the cart, so the test must open the menu.
why: Platform behaviour of the generated action group (featured actions), not a bug.
workaround: Test opens Actions and clicks the menu item. Not hidden or patched.

what: Quote lines and company price rows open on their own nested page. Invite a member is enabled only after the company prices are stored with Update.
why: Platform generated edit-page behaviour; Admin.quotes also needed updateable for the discount field.
workaround: Tests open the nested page, edit, Update, Back; Admin.quotes set updateable true.

what: About eight full generate and build cycles of two to three minutes each, plus sleeps of up to four minutes, for small label and feature changes.
why: Each label or feature change needs regeneration and build; no faster loop is used in the chunk.
workaround: Batched edits into one rebuild script (rebuild.sh).

what: A custom operation with an input and an output (buyGiftCard returning the code) produced a generated dialog that imports the output type twice; the Biome format step failed and the build stopped. Same bug as R8-5.
why: Generator bug with operations that have both input and output; no catalog route recorded.
workaround: buyGiftCard changed to a void operation; the new card shows in My gift cards.

what: The build of the generated e2e model logs many XMI ID COLLISION DETECTED errors for TabularReferenceField link actions; the build still succeeds.
why: Unknown; appears in generated model output.
workaround: None; build passed.

what: The test expected the e-mail as typed, but Keycloak stored and returned it lower-cased.
why: Keycloak lower-cases user names and e-mail addresses; the test did not account for it.
workaround: The test helper lower-cases names and addresses.

what: In the generated checkout dialog, typing the address sometimes sent stray digits to the loyalty points field, and the field's role made fill fail.
why: Builder's guess: the generated dialog loses focus while a debounced text field re-renders.
workaround: resetPoints helper clears and sets the field, waits for the debounce, then checks the value.

what: Loyalty points expire only by a call from an admin dashboard action or at checkout; there is no scheduled expiry job.
why: osgi-scheduled-background-jobs needs a scheduler module the generated runtime does not have, and a job has no request transaction.
workaround: LoyaltyService.expireAll(now) called from the admin action and at each checkout.

what: A custom page route for checkout needs src/extra-routes.tsx, which needs a .generator-ignore entry, which the standing rules forbid. So the step flow cannot have its own URL.
why: Extra routes are generated empty and only survive regeneration with an ignore entry; the standing rule and the route need conflict.
workaround: Flow lives inside the cart page; no /checkout URL.

what: The model build logged many 'XMI ID COLLISION DETECTED' errors for Admin tabular reference field actions, but the build still reported BUILD SUCCESS.
why: Not investigated in this chunk; likely a model/ID issue in the admin UI model.
proposed_target: judo model XMI ids for Admin tabular reference actions

what: Vite could not Fast Refresh a component file that also exports a non-component (renderNothing), so the page reloaded fully on each edit.
why: React Fast Refresh only handles component-only exports.
workaround: Accepted the full reload.
